description:
Stop wasting money on forgotten food. PantryPal transforms your grocery receipts into a smart pantry that helps you track food, manage inventory, and reduce waste.

SCAN IN SECONDS

Scan grocery receipts and automatically add items to your pantry
Scan product barcodes for quick item entry
Use AI-powered fridge scanning to identify food items from photos

STAY AHEAD OF EXPIRY

Automatic expiry date estimates for pantry items
Receive reminders before food expires
Easily see which items should be used first
Keep your pantry organized and up to date

COOK SMARTER

Discover recipes based on ingredients you already have
Generate personalized recipes using AI
Plan meals for the whole family
Save favorite recipes for future use

SHOP SMARTER

Create and manage shopping lists
Get suggestions for items that are running low
Check off items while shopping
Stay organized and avoid unnecessary purchases

PANTRYPAL PREMIUM

Upgrade to Premium for advanced features:

Unlimited receipt and fridge scans
7-day meal plans from what you already have
Batch cooking with portions for the fridge and freezer
Unlimited Leftover rescue meal ideas

Subscription Information

Weekly and Annual subscription plans available
Pricing is displayed in the app before purchase
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before renewal
Manage or cancel subscriptions through Apple ID Account Settings
No refunds are provided for unused portions of active subscription periods

YOUR DATA, YOUR CONTROL

Pantry data is stored locally on your device
No account required for core features
AI features use secure encrypted connections
Anonymous usage stats only (no name, email or ad ID), and you can turn them off in Settings
No ads
No tracking
No third-party analytics

Privacy Policy:
https://sites.google.com/view/pantrypal-app/privacy-policy

whatsNew:
A smarter PantryPal that helps you use food before it goes off.

• Plan meals from what you already have — see how many meals your pantry can make this week
• Batch cooking: cook once, with portions saved for the fridge and freezer
• Leftover rescue: pick what needs using and get 3 meal ideas
• "Cooked it" updates your pantry and keeps track of leftovers
• Faster, more accurate receipt and fridge scanning
• New "Use first" home screen showing what to eat soon
• Easier adding: scan, tap common foods, or just type "milk, eggs"
• Shopping list warns you before you buy something you already have
• One evening reminder instead of a notification per item
